name: mirage
text: Got your diagnostics report (from 11:52 PM last night). You didn't ask for anything specific, so I logged it and here is what I see. Needs you: 1) ParlayAPI key ending 10d2 is a free-plan key and is refused. Replace or remove it in Settings > APIs. 2) Android notifications are off for Vigilant, so no alerts. Turn them on in Android Settings > Apps > Vigilant. I'll look at: 3) bets.json is 8 MB and rewritten whole on every change, and cold start took 5.2 s. Both are lag sources and I'll prune or journal it. 4) Only $0 of your $81.84 is working in bids. This is already on my list as a bid-volume problem. 5) Results are 4 standard deviations below what the edges promised (-$110 against +$44 expected over 2,196 bets). That points to fair odds that are too optimistic, or to grading, and I'll check both. CNO's CLV is slightly negative (-0.6% on 106 bets). That is only a watch item for now. Tell me if you wanted something else from this report.
